definition: the science or practice of drawing maps

definition: including a wide variety of things; all-embracing
example: Her catholic tastes spanned continents.

definition: capable of burning or corroding; sharply critical
example: Her caustic wit alienated old friends.

definition: wary and unwilling to take risks
example: Be circumspect when signing the contract.

definition: sweet or sentimental to an excessive degree

definition: a small strongbox or chest for valuables

definition: secret or illegal cooperation for fraudulent purposes

definition: to accept and allow behavior that is considered wrong
example: We cannot condone such misconduct.

definition: an expert judge in matters of taste
example: He is a connoisseur of fine wines.

definition: stubbornly or willfully disobedient
example: The contumacious witness refused to testify.

definition: to pamper or protect excessively
example: She cosseted her youngest child shamelessly.

definition: a small exclusive group with shared interests
example: A literary coterie gathered at her salon.

definition: a steady increase in intensity or force
example: The campaign reached a crescendo in late spring.

definition: greedy desire for wealth or material gain
example: Their cupidity drove the speculation.

definition: a bad-tempered or surly person
example: The old curmudgeon refused to greet anyone.

definition: a young woman making her formal debut into society
example: The debutante was the talk of the ball.

definition: in keeping with good taste and propriety
example: Their decorous behavior impressed the host.

definition: to spoil the appearance of something
example: The statue was defaced by graffiti.

definition: causing harm or damage
example: The policy had deleterious effects on workers.

definition: to remove the moisture from; to dry out
example: The sun desiccated the seeds.

definition: a formal pronouncement or maxim
example: He repeated the dictum about the source.

definition: to make or become wider or more open
example: Her eyes dilated in surprise.

definition: a person with a superficial interest in something
example: He was a dilettante in three fields.

definition: a mournful song or piece of music
example: The orchestra played a slow dirge.

definition: essentially different in kind; not comparable
example: The committee was split between disparate factions.
